text_block_list.text:
"Entering her Classic Year, Yukino Bijin 
was growing by leaps and bounds."
choice_data_list: Good work, let's take a break for now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is that it for the uphill track? I feel 
like I could run a bunch more, though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's not like I'm pushin' myself too 
hard, really, my legs still feel super 
light!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's thanks to your body growing

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So that means you've gotten used 
to it, huh?
choice_data_list:
Shall we switch to a more intensive 
training regimen?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, so I really am growing, huh. That 
makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"If I keep doing my best like this, maybe 
I can get a good result at the Oka Sho 
too..."

On the Triple Tiara route where top 
contenders clash— she has what it takes to 
aim for victory even in the first leg, the 
Oka Sho. That conviction only grew 
stronger.

The next day. Since it was a rest day, I 
was out shopping at Yukino Bijin's 
request, when—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Huh! Aren't you... the "Snow Angel"!?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~! Wow, you're super cute in person 
too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hae? "Snow Angel"?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you don't know?! Your photo is going 
super viral! ...Look!

Saying that, they showed me a post on 
social media. On it was—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya!? It's me!

There was a photo of Yukino Bijin, 
seemingly taken after the Hanshin JF. She 
was smiling happily.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"I saw this photo featured on a morning 
show today!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
The person who posted it said they snapped 
it by chance. "A miraculous shot! The snow 
angel descends"... Talk about hitting the 
nail on the head.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san! Quit teasin' me like that, 
would ya!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, your personality is so totally 
angelic too... Um, were you an idol?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nope! I run in races too, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that right! I'm rooting for you, do 
your best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that the girl who was on TV 
this morning...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. If I get a selfie together, maybe 
I'll go viral too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—Everyone, have you seen this photo? Yes, 
it's the one buzzing all over the internet 
recently, known as the 'Snow Angel'!”

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"With such an ethereal presence, online 
comments are exploding with 'Too cute!' 
and 'Is she literally an angel?!' Let's 
investigate—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeh~...! It really got featured on 
TV...!

Last year, when she announced her bid for 
the Triple Tiara, it caused quite a stir 
online too. Back then, it was still just 
talk among certain circles, but—

Thanks to being featured on terrestrial 
television this time, it has become known 
to even more people, accelerating the 
craze even further.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I never thought things would turn out like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But! A boom is an opportunity, 
right?!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That means more people will surely come to 
watch our races, which means...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I can get results under those 
conditions, everyone's bound to go, 
"Ooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Calling me cute... is a bit embarrassing, 
though, even if I am really happy to hear 
it..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Yukino Bijin is so cool!" Everyone's 
gonna think that, right!?
choice_data_list: I'm sure they'll see it that way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Somehow... I'm feeling totally pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They told me I've been improving, too! I'm 
gonna keep at it like this~!

"If there were any concerns, it was the 
effect of the surrounding hype... but so 
far, there doesn't seem to be an issue."

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me... You're the "Snow Angel", 
aren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyawa! P-Please spare me from being called 
that, I beg of ye!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Waaaah~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, you look awfully exhausted. Didn't 
you have today off?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-san! Good evening.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Hishi Amazon-san, the dorm head. She's so 
kind and always looking out for everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It was my day off, but so many people 
called out to me today...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I heard you were 
featured on TV! Isn't that amazing?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. But it was just so overwhelming 
that my head started spinning.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Well, if things get too 
tough, you can always rely on Big Sis 
Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Since I haven't debuted yet, race troubles 
are a bit tricky for me, but I'll stick 
with ya until we find an answer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-san...! Thank ya kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're here with me, Trainer, so I 
think I'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then good. I know better than anyone that 
you're a tough kid.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to make a massive debut next 
year myself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wah! Is that so!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to running with you 
too! Give it your best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes.
(Rrrr-ring...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You passed your badge test! If I 
remember right, you'd been aiming for 
Level 6 for a while, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To enter the tournament, I gotta take that 
super important skills test... Man, Level 
6 is crazy hard though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Mifuyu-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Though, if I'm aiming for the 
world stage, I still need to pass the 7th 
grade test too."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"At my age, all the talented kids have 
long since passed... The starting line 
feels so impossibly far away."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"But hey! Yuki-chan, you're about to take 
on some tough races yourself, right? When 
I think about that, I can't afford to just 
stand still!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"To tell you the truth, ever since I 
watched Yuki-chan's race, I've been doing 
great! Even my teacher praised me!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, ain't that awesome! I'm in pretty 
good shape myself...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even when we're apart, we really are 
similar, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, time for a bath. Ended up on 
the phone for way too long again."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
""Oh, you're right. It's totally dark 
outside now... The stars look really 
beautiful over here. How about over 
there?""

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Umm... Stars...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Can't see it too clearly, though. Still...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So pretty...
